methods.source: Public Reddit threads, X posts or publisher openings

action.query: ("looking for" OR "need a" OR "seeking") "{serviceTerm}" {market} (paid OR freelance OR contract)

methods.minimumEvidence: Open the dated buyer-authored original. Distinguish an open commission, supplier RFQ, software evaluation and a recommendation request; recheck closure and reply invitations. Exclude a seller advertising their own product. A full-time job is separate from a freelance commission.
methods.requires: Use the assistant’s included public search and open readable buyer originals. If the host cannot search or the originals are inaccessible, record that limit. Paid native Reddit or X searches require their own quote and seller approval.
methods.cost: Use included host search only. Any separately billed access needs a quote.

provenance.label: Age and buyer wording on X at 0:38
A design commission can already be closed at 9:30

methods.source: Business listings and the business’s own site
methods.minimumEvidence: Confirm current business, service area and official website; corroborate a missing site or specific problem on first-party evidence before claiming it. A directory phone is a general business number.
methods.requires: City or area, supplied by the seller or existing context. Use the public-request lane while this is unknown.
methods.cost: Request live quote before collection or website checks. Hosting may add usage.

methods.source: Active YouTube channels and official studio sites
methods.minimumEvidence: Look for regular long-form episodes and an attributable production contact. Link the published episode with its timestamp when describing a concrete issue. Upload frequency and editing style do not establish an open commission.
methods.requires: Supported country and two-letter language. Where missing, start with included host search for active channels with no assumed country; only propose a country for approval.
methods.cost: Actor quote before channel discovery. Any public search must be included in the host.

methods.source: Company hiring posts and their original vacancies
methods.minimumEvidence: Read the original posting and source date. A vacancy identifies an employer and possible need. Only an open request explicitly accepting contractors or agency services establishes commissioned work.
methods.requires: Current owned routing and job coverage; follow the returned plan and supported search filters.
methods.cost: Route and quote first. Confirm source scope and cap before paid discovery.

methods.source: Owned B2B company discovery, then official business websites
methods.minimumEvidence: Confirm that the organization does the relevant work and the contact holds a current matching role. Record official source. Company fit or a sourced business address alone is not proof of demand, ownership or deliverability.
methods.requires: Use returned supported B2B sources; if the Actor requests meaningful missing criteria, use existing context or ask one targeted question.
methods.cost: Route and quote before collection. Follow current price and approval for enrichment.

methods.source: Retail directories, Maps and independent retailers’ own catalogs
methods.minimumEvidence: Confirm location, actual assortment, wholesale fit and buying contact on the retailer’s own site. Listing the category establishes fit; a dated request for suppliers is separate evidence.
methods.requires: A real market for the Maps route. Else use included public search for retailer assortment and stockist pages.
methods.cost: Plan first; approval before paid business search or contact enrichment.

methods.source: Google organic business results and first-party sites
methods.minimumEvidence: Confirm the official site and a concrete service-relevant gap. Organic ranking alone cannot establish advertised spend, buying demand or an individual owner.
methods.requires: One actual niche and city/area with supported country/language. When unavailable, use a permitted public search or B2B route instead.
methods.cost: Plan returns source event cap. Include any platform usage in the seller’s budget.

segments: independent retailers stocking the relevant category
organizations with the problem the software solves

fallback.requiresInference: For an understandable unfamiliar offer, the assistant derives at least two concrete purchasing segments, a likely buying role and a searchable deliverable from the paid outcome. Pass the first hypothesis to the company search and retain the alternatives. For an opaque label ask what customers pay for.

evidencePolicy: Return actual cited prospects only after discovery. Tutorials illustrate methods. Never use a featured business, person, or old commissioning post as a seed.
